title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds $63,932 after a modest 0.7% gain into the US close, even as Fear & Greed sits at 25 in extreme fear territory. Network strength stands out with hashrate at 793.7 EH/s and a jammed mempool of 98k transactions keeping fees at just 2 sat/vB. 

Key takeaway: price resilience amid capitulation signals. Overnight, watch for volume spikes or any push above $64k; low-fee environment could fuel quick moves if sentiment shifts. Block height at 958,477.
